findings.evidence: Lines 154-158 only check provenance element types/nonemptiness; lines 173-182 merely test heading-set membership and substring presence in the entire file. No later use of `provenance`, `roadmap_heading`, or `roadmap_quote` exists.
findings.fix: Validate provenance as resolvable PR references that establish the target PR’s relationship to the roadmap, parse genuine Markdown headings, and require the quote within the selected heading’s section.
findings.issue: `validate_evidence` treats any nonempty string list as provenance and independently accepts a heading and quote anywhere in the file, so fabricated provenance such as `["garbage"]` and an unrelated quote can authorize a false roadmap attribution.

summary: The migration can assign roadmap labels using evidence that does not establish any relationship between the target PR and the cited roadmap target.
